name: code-server
description: Run VS Code in the browser, enabling remote development from any device with a web browser.

env.label: Access Password
env.description: Password to access the code-server web interface

env.label: Sudo Password
env.description: Password for sudo access inside the container

env.label: Hashed Password
env.description: Argon2 hashed password for code-server access (overrides PASSWORD if set)

env.label: Hashed Sudo Password
env.description: Argon2 hashed sudo password (overrides SUDO_PASSWORD if set)

env.label: Default Workspace
env.description: Default directory to open when code-server starts

env.label: Proxy Domain
env.description: Domain to proxy requests for (e.g. code-server.mydomain.com)
